description: This file defines the ReplicationManager for Kubernetes, which manages synchronization of ReplicationController objects with running pods. It wraps around the ReplicaSetController and provides initialization with informers, clients, and configuration.

classes.name: ReplicationManager
classes.description: A struct that embeds replicaset.ReplicaSetController and manages synchronization of ReplicationController objects.

methods.name: NewReplicationManager
methods.description: Constructor function that initializes a new ReplicationManager with context, informers, client, and configuration parameters.
